rows.content: On duty at the First Court today. No one dares look up at the Mirror of Retribution.
Judge Cui's vermilion brush has snapped again, the third this month.
Meng Po has a new recipe. Less coptis, she says.
The queue for the First Court reaches the gate. Quiet, please.
The water is rising under Naihe Bridge. Ferrymen, take care.
